info.name: Bank Microservices - employee-service
info.description: Onboard staff (admin-only, calls auth-service to assign a role) and view/update employee profiles. Run auth-service's 'Admin Login' request first (from the other collection) to get an admin_token.

variable.description: Swap to http://localhost:8080/api/employees to go through api-gateway instead
Paste from auth-service's Admin Login response, or share the environment so it's auto-filled
A FRESH token for the newly-onboarded user - see the note on 'Get my profile' below

request.description: 'username' must belong to someone who already self-registered via auth-service (e.g. run auth-service's Register request for 'jane' first, if you haven't already). Requires admin_token. role must be ROLE_TELLER, ROLE_MANAGER, or ROLE_ADMIN.

IMPORTANT: use a FRESH token here, not the one 'jane' had before onboarding. A JWT is only a snapshot of roles at the moment it was issued - onboarding changes roles in auth-service's database, but doesn't retroactively update any token already handed out. Log 'jane' in again via auth-service's Login request AFTER onboarding, then paste that new token into employee_token.
Requires ROLE_MANAGER or ROLE_ADMIN. Adjust the ID to match whatever was returned by Onboard employee.
Job title/department only - role changes go through auth-service, not here.
